mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, cert_code, exam_score, status, passed_at, expire_at FROM t_certification WHERE worker_id = #{param1} AND cert_code = #{param2} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_certification (worker_id, cert_code, exam_score, status, passed_at, expire_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{certCode}, #{examScore}, #{status}, #{passedAt}, #{expireAt}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE exam_score = VALUES(exam_score), status = VALUES(status), passed_at = VALUES(passed_at), expire_at = VALUES(expire_at), updated_at = NOW()
